photometry module

Module to provide tools for photometry

class darclight.photometry.Photometer(fwhm, output='output', target='none', fov=19.0)[source]

Bases: object

Class to perform basic photometry

find_ref_stars(data, ref_ra, ref_dec, gaia_data_file=None)[source]

finds the pixel positions of reference stars in a given image.

Parameters:

  • data (np.ndarray) – the image data where the reference stars should be found

  • ref_ra (np.ndarray) – array of R.A. values in degree for the reference stars

  • ref_dec (np.ndarray) – array of the declination values in degree for the reference stars

  • max_mag (float, optional) – the limiting magnitude, used for a gaia query to find the reference stars, defaults to 16.

  • gaia_data_file (str | None, optional) – file that contains gaia data of the region. Needs to have the following three entries: ‘phot_g_mean_mag’, ‘ra’ and ‘dec’, defaults to None

Returns:

returns a Tuple of pixel positions in both axis

Return type:

Tuple[list[float], list[float]]

mark_stars(data, pixels)[source]

Marks the reference stars in a given image with a circle and a number

Parameters:

  • data (np.ndarray) – image data where the reference stars should be marked

  • pixels (np.ndarray) – iterable that has the pixel positions in the form [[x1, y1], [x2, y2], …]
